Deepika Padukone Shares Pregnancy Experiences Online

Actress Deepika Padukone shared a video detailing her experiences during her second pregnancy, focusing on managing her first child's needs. The reel, posted on Instagram, depicted relatable challenges of pregnancy. Padukone is expecting her second child with actor Ranveer Singh. The video highlighted the demands of caring for an elder child while pregnant.
